# rauthy_client (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Rauthy OIDC client by `id`, for referring to clients this configuration does not manage.

Requires the `Clients:read` API key right.

The client secret is intentionally not exposed here. Reading it requires the separate `Secrets:read` right and a second API call, and a data source is the wrong place to write a credential into state for a client this configuration does not own and is not responsible for rotating. Use the `rauthy_client` resource, which does expose `secret`, for a client Terraform manages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Refer to an OIDC client that was created outside this configuration.
#
# The client secret is intentionally not exposed here; use the rauthy_client
# resource instead for a client Terraform manages and is responsible for
# rotating.
data "rauthy_client" "billing" {
  id = "billing-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The client id to look up, as used in OIDC requests.

### Read-Only

- `access_token_alg` (String) Signing algorithm for access tokens: `RS256`, `RS384`, `RS512` or `EdDSA`.
- `access_token_lifetime` (Number) Lifetime of an access token in seconds.
- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) Additional CORS origins, as `scheme://host[:port]` with no path.
- `auth_code_lifetime` (Number) Lifetime of an authorization code in seconds.
- `backchannel_logout_uri` (String) OIDC back-channel logout endpoint of the application.
- `challenges` (Set of String) Accepted PKCE challenge methods: `plain`, `S256`. Rauthy requires `S256` from public clients regardless of this setting.
- `client_uri` (String) Informational URI of the application.
- `confidential` (Boolean) Whether the client authenticates with a secret. A public client (`false`) has no secret and Rauthy requires S256 PKCE from it.
- `contacts` (Set of String) Contact addresses for the application's maintainers.
- `default_scopes` (Set of String) Scopes granted even when the client does not ask for them.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the client may be used to log in.
- `flows_enabled` (Set of String) Enabled OAuth 2.0 flows: `authorization_code`, `client_credentials`, `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code`, `password`, `refresh_token`.
- `force_mfa` (Boolean) Whether MFA is required for users logging in through this client.
- `id_token_alg` (String) Signing algorithm for id tokens: `RS256`, `RS384`, `RS512` or `EdDSA`.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name, shown on the login page.
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (Set of String) Allowed redirect URIs after a logout.
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) Allowed redirect URIs.
- `restrict_group_prefix` (String) Restricts logins to users in groups starting with this prefix.
- `scim` (Attributes) SCIM provisioning configured against the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scim))
- `scopes` (Set of String) Scopes the client may request.

<a id="nestedatt--scim"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scim`

Read-Only:

- `base_uri` (String) Base URI of the SCIM endpoint.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token Rauthy presents to the SCIM endpoint.
- `group_sync_prefix` (String) Only groups starting with this prefix are synchronised.
- `sync_groups` (Boolean) Whether groups are synchronised as well as users.
